zh-Hans.subtitle: 本地AI分类与相册整理
zh-Hans.promotionalText: 按你的习惯整理相册：编辑内置分类规则，选择本地模型，滑动连续多选。已有分类不会因更新自动改变；在线模型仅在你配置并选择后用于处理。
zh-Hans.description:
ImagePilot 是一款本地优先的照片与视频整理工具，帮助你按内容和文件信息浏览相册、查找相似照片并整理收藏。

【选择适合自己的 AI 模型】
支持本地 AI 分类，提供 Gemma 2 等模型选项。部分模型需要先联网下载，下载完成后可在设备端识别照片。也可自行配置在线模型服务；只有选择在线服务进行处理时，相关图片才会发送至该服务。不同模型的能力和速度会有所不同。

【让分类规则适合你的相册】
使用人物、宠物、美食、风景、建筑、植物、文档等内置分类，或创建自己的类别。可编辑内置规则、补充画面场景和排除条件，并恢复默认。自然语言规则适用于支持该能力的模型，固定标签模型不支持。修改规则不会自动改变已经整理好的照片，需主动重新分类才应用新规则。

【更方便地浏览和整理】
按内容、城市、颜色及文件信息浏览；查找相似照片，长按滑动连续选择多张照片。使用暂存箱集中检查待处理照片，再确认删除或归档。

【照片与视频一起管理】
支持视频分类。初次识别为“其他”时，可从不同位置补取视频帧再次识别。可查看分类匹配详情，并导出文本诊断用于反馈问题。

【时刻、报告与编辑】
回顾照片中的时刻与回忆，制作时刻秀和相册报告；使用修图、滤镜和相关本地编辑工具处理照片。

【数据由你管理】
提供分类索引备份与恢复。使用本地模型分类时，推理在设备上完成；使用你配置的在线服务时，相关图片按该服务的处理方式传输。模型下载及在线功能需要网络。

AI 分类可能出现误判，你可以调整分类规则或手动修改分类。
zh-Hans.whatsNew:
本次更新提升分类规则的可调整性与相册整理体验：

• 优化自定义规则与场景的共同匹配，并补充商品详情、功能宣传图的分类。
• 新增内置分类规则编辑，支持补充场景、排除条件和恢复默认；保留自定义分类。
• 优化人物主体与景观背景的区分，调整运动健身默认规则，移除游泳相关描述。
• 重新 AI 分类时可选择不同模型；本地模型下载后使用，已配置的在线服务也可选择。
• 优化待分类照片和视频的模型选择界面。
• 支持长按滑动连续多选，修复返回目录后残留选中状态的问题。
• 视频初次分类为“其他”时，可补取不同帧再次识别。
• 分类诊断支持导出文本文件，方便反馈问题。
• 加强旧数据迁移与扫描异常时的保护，备份支持保存修改后的内置规则。

更新不会自动重新分类已有照片。新规则用于后续分类或主动重新分类；用户已编辑的规则保持不变。

en-US.subtitle: Local AI photo organizer
en-US.promotionalText: Make photo categories your own with editable rules, local AI models and drag selection. Existing classifications stay in place when you update.
en-US.description:
ImagePilot is a local-first photo and video organizer. Browse your library by content and file information, find similar photos, and keep your collection organized.

CHOOSE YOUR AI MODEL
Use on-device AI classification with options including Gemma 2. Some local models require an initial download; image recognition then runs on your device. You can also configure an online model provider. Images processed with an online service are sent to that provider. Model capabilities and speed vary.

MAKE CATEGORIES YOUR OWN
Use built-in categories for people, pets, food, scenery, buildings, plants, documents, and more, or create custom categories. Edit built-in rules, add visual scenarios and exclusions, and restore defaults. Natural-language rules work with supported models, not fixed-label models. Editing a rule does not automatically change existing classifications; choose reclassification to apply it.

BROWSE AND ORGANIZE
Browse by content, city, color, and file information. Find similar photos and select consecutive items with a long press and drag. Collect items in the staging box for review before confirming deletion or archiving.

MANAGE PHOTOS AND VIDEOS
Classify videos as well as photos. Videos initially classified as Other can be retried with additional frames. View matching details and export text diagnostics when reporting a problem.

MEMORIES, REPORTS AND EDITING
Revisit moments and memories, create Showtime reels and album reports, and use photo-editing tools and filters.

MANAGE YOUR DATA
Back up and restore your classification index. Local-model inference runs on your device. When you choose your configured online service, the relevant images are transmitted for processing by that service. Model downloads and online features require a network connection.

AI classification may be incorrect. You can adjust category rules or change a classification manually.
en-US.whatsNew:
This update makes classification rules easier to customize and improves photo-library organization.

• Improve joint matching of custom rules and scenarios, and recognize product detail and promotional graphics.
• Edit built-in category rules, add visual scenarios and exclusions, or restore defaults. Custom categories are preserved.
• Refine the distinction between a main subject and its background. Swimming descriptions have been removed from the default Sports & Fitness rules.
• Choose a model when reclassifying photos. Download supported local models or select an online service you have configured.
• Simplify model selection for unclassified photos and videos.
• Select consecutive photos with a long press and drag. Fix selection state remaining after leaving a category.
• Retry videos classified as Other using additional frames.
• Export classification diagnostics as a text file.
• Improve protection during database upgrades and scan failures. Backups now include edited built-in rules.

Updating does not automatically reclassify existing photos. New rules apply to future or explicitly requested classification. Your edited rules are preserved.
